observations: Two wooden-top tables sitting on black cast-iron treadle sewing-machine legs/stands, photographed outdoors on bare ground and broken concrete.

Each tabletop has a rectangular cutout meant to hold a sewing-machine head; in photo 2 and 3 the cutout is empty, showing bare dirt/concrete through or under it, confirming no machine head is included.
One iron base has a treadle wheel and flywheel mechanism visible (photo 3), the other base's wheel is not clearly visible.
Table tops show different finishes: one blue/grey marbled laminate, one brown wood-grain laminate; a ruler/measuring strip is glued along one table's edge (photo 2).
Watermarks 'SESHMAK TECH' and 'Posted on Jiji' overlay all images; no brand, model, or serial plate is visible on the iron legs.
No sewing machine head, motor, belt, or weaving equipment is shown in any photo despite the listing title mentioning 'Sewing and Weaving machine legs'.

identity.kind: treadle sewing machine table/legs (iron stand with wooden top, no machine head)

claims.evidence: Photos show iron treadle stands with tabletops; no weaving equipment or sewing machine head is visible in any of the 4 photos, so only the 'legs/stand' part is supported, the 'weaving' function is unverifiable_remote.

risks.risk: No sewing machine head is included, so buyer gets only the table/stand, not a functional sewing machine.
risks.proof: A photo showing a mounted machine head in the cutout, or explicit confirmation that only the frame/table is sold.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare stand/table only, no machine functionality

risks.risk: Treadle mechanism (wheel, pedal, belt linkage) condition and whether it still turns smoothly is unknown.
risks.proof: A short video of the treadle being pumped and the wheel spinning.

risks.risk: Rust or structural weakness in the iron legs from outdoor storage on bare ground is possible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of leg joints and welds, and of the underside for rust/corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having surface rust / possible weak joints

risks.risk: Tabletop lamination/veneer condition (peeling, water damage) not fully visible from distance.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tabletop edges and surface.

risks.risk: Two different stands/tables are shown; unclear if both are included in the 48k price or sold separately.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing of whether both units are included for the stated price.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit only, worst case

proof_requests: Close-up of tabletop edges and lamination condition
Video of treadle wheel/pedal mechanism in motion
Confirmation whether both tables/stands are included in the stated price or sold individually
Close-up of iron leg joints and base for rust or cracks
response.reason: Item is clearly identifiable as bare treadle sewing-machine table/leg stands (no machine head, no weaving gear), so it can be priced at worst case as a non-functional furniture frame pending proof of mechanism condition and whether one or two units are included.
